_meta.description: Curated sentences with a missing prefix. Kid picks from 4 prefix options which one fits the context. Teaches prefixes as meaning-changers in real use.

items.sentence: The scientist wanted to ___do the experiment because it failed the first time.
items.meaning: re- means 'again'; she wants to do it again

items.sentence: She had to ___lock the door to get inside.
items.meaning: un- means 'reverse'; the door was locked and she opened it

items.sentence: The teacher gave a ___view of tomorrow's lesson.
items.meaning: pre- means 'before'; a view given before

items.sentence: I keep ___placing my glasses around the house.
items.meaning: mis- means 'wrongly'; putting them in the wrong place

items.sentence: After the storm, we had to ___build the treehouse.
items.meaning: re- means 'again'; build it again after damage

items.sentence: The twins often ___agree about which movie to watch.
items.meaning: dis- means 'not'; they don't agree

items.sentence: When we got to the hotel, we started to ___pack our suitcases.
items.meaning: un- means 'reverse'; take things out of the pack

items.sentence: You need to ___pay for the ticket before boarding.
items.meaning: pre- means 'before'; pay before you go

items.sentence: It's easy to ___spell words with double letters.
items.meaning: mis- means 'wrongly'; spell them incorrectly

items.sentence: The editor asked me to ___write my story with a stronger ending.
items.meaning: re- means 'again'; write it again

items.sentence: The puppy was ___happy when its owner left for work.
items.meaning: un- means 'not'; not happy

items.sentence: My little brother goes to ___school before he starts kindergarten.
items.meaning: pre- means 'before'; school before regular school

items.sentence: The car began to ___heat after driving up the mountain.
items.meaning: over- means 'too much'; heat too much

items.sentence: The magician made the coin ___appear right before our eyes.
items.meaning: dis- means 'not'; stop appearing

items.sentence: I ___read the sign and turned the wrong way.
items.meaning: mis- means 'wrongly'; read it wrong

items.sentence: It was so hot that he had to ___button his jacket.
items.meaning: un- means 'reverse'; undo the buttons

items.sentence: The election was so close they had to ___count the votes.
items.meaning: re- means 'again'; count them again to be sure

items.sentence: The weather report tries to ___dict what tomorrow will be like.
items.meaning: pre- + dict = 'say before'; forecast the future

items.sentence: After being lied to, she began to ___trust her friend.
items.meaning: dis- means 'not'; stop trusting

items.sentence: Try not to ___eat at Thanksgiving dinner or you'll feel sick.
items.meaning: over- means 'too much'; eat too much

items.sentence: The birds ___turn to their nests every spring.
items.meaning: re- means 'back'; turn back to the nest

items.sentence: On my birthday, I get to ___wrap all my presents.
items.meaning: un- means 'reverse'; take the wrapping off

items.sentence: Don't ___judge someone before you get to know them.
items.meaning: mis- means 'wrongly'; judge incorrectly

items.sentence: The label says to ___wash new jeans in cold water.
items.meaning: pre- means 'before'; wash before you wear them

items.sentence: Please ___connect the printer before you move it.
items.meaning: dis- means 'apart'; take apart the connection

items.sentence: Try not to ___react over small things.
items.meaning: over- means 'too much'; react more than needed

items.sentence: When the computer freezes, you can ___start it.
items.meaning: re- means 'again'; start it once more

items.sentence: The turtle was ___able to reach the leaves on the top of the plant.
items.meaning: un- means 'not'; not able to do it

items.sentence: Puppies sometimes ___behave when they get too excited.
items.meaning: mis- means 'wrongly'; behave badly

items.sentence: This restaurant lets you ___order your food online.
items.meaning: pre- means 'before'; order in advance
